notes.title: Update 18.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed calling artillery
[*] Increased aircraft speed, reduced cost of calling it
[*] Lumberjacks no longer swing their axes through the air
[*] Trees fall after being cut, rather than simply disappearing
[*] Optimized visual effects
[*] Added new sound effects
[*] Small decor sprites, bullets, shells, sparks, etc. have been redrawn.
[*] Increased rate of fire of anti-aircraft guns
[*] Concrete blocks and steel beams shatter into pieces when destroyed
[*] Increased gun accuracy
[*] Fixed bug with eagle
[*] Added survival mode with huge enemy onslaught
[*] Added 3 achievements to survival mode
[/list]

notes.title: Update 17.0
notes.content:
Today Glad Valakas turned 54 years old, in honor of this an update was made:

[list]
[*] Game processes have been optimized
[*] Improved visual effects
[*] Sprites of trees and bakeries have been redrawn
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[*] Improved some sound effects
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who plays and supports this horror story, surprisingly there are those repulsed people who played for more than 50 hours, my respect! I hope it will reach new levels.

“It doesn’t matter how, it doesn’t matter where, the main thing is together”

notes.title: Update to version 15.0
notes.content:
A century later, it was done:

[list]
[*] Game processes optimized
[*] Changed the effects of explosions, smoke, sparks
[*] Redrawn some sprites
[*] Added the ability to select units, as well as the order to "retreat"
[*] Fixed problem with sound overload
[*] Added sound effects 
[/list]

notes.title: Update to version 12.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The sniper has increased accuracy and shot range
[*] Graphic changes, added new sounds
[*] Added physical animation of death of units, enemy and friendly
[*] Antiaircraft and cannon now attack enemy ships
[/list]

Mission section and multiplayer in development

notes.title: Upgrade to version 11.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added level and achievements
[*] Fixed bug with achievements
[*] Increased movement speed of woodcutters and miners
[*] Now the miner will not go beyond the boundaries of the level if the mine is not built
[*] Dropping of paratroopers from the liner is now less frequent
[*] And other little thing
[/list]

At the moment, we are studying the technical issues for introducing a multiplayer game mode with a friend or a random player in HOM2.

HOM3 was an experimental game for a very narrow circle of people, and it was not fundamentally like the previous part. Now we are developing a new strategy Military Crusaders, similar to Heroes Of Maidan 2, but in a different setting and new features, I will be grateful if you add to your wishlist. Thanks.

notes.title: Update to version 10.0
notes.content:
Added new units for the enemy:
[list]
[*] Spetsnaz
[*] A Mi-8 helicopter with a machine gun on board, special forces are being dropped
[/list]
Added for the side of Ukraine:
[list]
[*] Antiaircraft gun
[*] New research for more oil growth
[*] Trump support, gives 5000 oil
[/list]
[list]
[*] The identified bugs have been fixed
[*] The warring parties are balanced
[*] A limitation has been placed on the number of buildings (blocks, turrets, etc.) to avoid overloading the level, and so that the player does not arrange large blockages (heaps) of blocks.
[*] The enemy plane no longer flies through blocks
[*] Some sprites have been slightly changed
[*] Added winter level
[*] New Year's menu
[/list]

The game is not abandoned, in the future there will be new levels and fixes of found bugs.

If you notice a bug, then write in the discussion of the game.
